gate.name: nextjs
gate.description: Classify the type of task in a Next.js issue by its primary intent

classes.label: font
classes.description: Fixing or enhancing next/font behavior: Google Fonts loading, local font configuration, font preloading, CSS font-family mismatches, or Turbopack font resolution
utterances: allow next/font/google to accept axes combined with a discrete weight for variable fonts instead of throwing an error
fix font preload link tags not being emitted when using multi-dot pageExtensions like 'page.tsx'
fix Turbopack crashing in pages/_app.tsx when next/font is imported alongside global CSS
fix next/font/local custom font-family declaration causing a mismatch between @font-face and className CSS output
fix next/font/google failing to build on 16.2.x due to broken Turbopack font resolution and http2 errors
fix localFont not accepting arrays of strings for multiple weights while Google fonts do
fix proxy-generated Link header values accumulating duplicate font preloads after cache revalidation
fix font optimization dramatically changing the appearance of rendered text due to woff2 subsetting

classes.label: documentation
classes.description: Improving, fixing, or requesting Next.js documentation: broken links, missing guides, incorrect API references, outdated content, or unclear examples
utterances: document how to configure eslint-config-next in the ESLint flat config format alongside the legacy eslintrc
fix broken links in config-shared.d.ts pointing to non-existent nextjs.org documentation pages
document how to properly combine multiple middleware files each with their own matcher config
fix the installation guide causing React compatibility issues by suggesting React 18 with Next.js 15 App Router
document that experimental PPR is not yet available in stable Next.js releases despite being mentioned in docs
add a tutorial for installing and configuring Vitest with Next.js for beginners
document how to use opengraph-image and twitter-image inside catch-all routes with proper params
update the cookies documentation to correctly reflect that cookies() returns ReadonlyRequestCookies not a Promise

classes.label: performance
classes.description: Addressing memory leaks, high RAM usage, slow builds, increased TBT, bundle size regressions, cache inefficiency, or other performance degradations in Next.js
utterances: fix @next/swc-darwin-arm64 allocating multiple large buffers causing excessive memory pressure on macOS
fix Turbopack dev server using too much RAM during long-running development sessions
fix memory leak from retained sandbox timers and ArrayBuffer per request in the App Router
fix next build workers stripping --max-old-space-size from NODE_OPTIONS causing OOM in large projects
fix Turbopack persistent dev cache always invalidating and never hitting, wasting rebuild time
fix router.refresh() eagerly refetching all data even for routes that haven't changed, causing unnecessary server load
fix Flight payload repeating the full chunk list on every streamed response instead of sending a delta
fix next/image decreasing Lighthouse performance scores due to blocking layout shifts

classes.label: image
classes.description: Fixing or enhancing next/image behavior: image optimization, sizing, placeholders, caching, ImageResponse, OpenGraph images, or static image imports
utterances: fix next/image not properly sizing images when CSS is used to override dimensions, producing a warning
fix ImageResponse failing after an uncached next/link navigation due to a stale module reference
fix basePath not being applied to next/image public URLs causing broken image paths in production
fix a single 0-byte file in .next/cache/images breaking the entire image optimization pipeline
fix image-component.js deviceSizes.sort() crashing when the array contains duplicate or non-numeric values
fix next/image stale cache in development mode when source images are modified without a server restart
fix statically imported images in Next.js 16.2 pages router not being recognized during build
fix OpenGraph-Image generation unable to locate static files referenced in the image JSX template
